notes: One entry per highlight video on /highlights. `npm run notion:sync -- highlights` copies this list into the Notion highlights database; the site reads Notion and falls back to this file.
`youtube` takes any YouTube link or a bare id. `title` is English; `titles` holds the other languages. `order` is the position in the default (featured) sort.
`start` / `end` (seconds) play only part of the video; Notion shows them in the Clip Time column.
